conf.description: OpenShift node/container ViaQ json logs (journald + container stdout/stderr): no Elastic Kubernetes-integration pipeline fits the ViaQ shape, so hand-build the field mapping into logs-kubernetes.container_logs - strip the cri-o:// prefix, split container image into name/tag, map ViaQ envelope keys to ECS/custom.

conf.comment: OpenShift node/container ViaQ json logs via ClusterLogForwarder http output. No stock Elastic integration fits this ViaQ wire shape, so this pipeline hand-shapes the record: ECS mapping for host/level/namespace/container/cluster, custom kubernetes.pod.*/openshift.log_* for the rest, cri-o:// prefix stripped, image split into name/tag.
